en.post:
Big Tech earnings thread 🧵

1/ Amazon's revenue hit $143.1 billion in calendar Q3 2023. Retail is back.

2/ NVIDIA is a different universe: fiscal 2024 revenue was $60.9 billion, more than double the year before.

3/ Meanwhile Tesla grew revenue 3% in full-year 2025. Not exactly hypergrowth.

4/ Apple pulled in $391.0 billion of revenue in fiscal 2024.

5/ My take: Apple will cross $500 billion in revenue by 2027, and NVDA at 30x sales is still cheap.

claims.quote: Amazon's revenue hit $143.1 billion in calendar Q3 2023.
claims.claim: Amazon reported revenue of $143.1 billion in calendar Q3 2023.
claims.summary: AMZN CY2023Q3 revenue reported as $143.083B, rounding to claimed $143.1B.

program_checks.text: Amazon revenue in calendar Q3 2023 was $143.1 billion

claims.quote: fiscal 2024 revenue was $60.9 billion, more than double the year before.
claims.claim: NVIDIA reported revenue of $60.9 billion in fiscal 2024, more than double the year before.
claims.summary: NVIDIA reported FY2024 fiscal revenue of $60,922,000,000, matching the claimed $60.9 billion within rounding (0.04%), and YoY growth of 125.85% from $26,974,000,000 in FY2023 confirms revenue more than doubled.

program_checks.text: NVIDIA fiscal 2024 revenue more than doubled the year before

claims.quote: Meanwhile Tesla grew revenue 3% in full-year 2025.
claims.claim: Tesla grew revenue 3% in full-year 2025.
claims.summary: Tesla FY2025 revenue was $94,827,000,000 vs FY2024 $97,690,000,000, a YoY decline of -2.93%, contradicting claimed 3% growth.

claims.quote: Apple pulled in $391.0 billion of revenue in fiscal 2024.
claims.claim: Apple reported revenue of $391.0 billion in fiscal 2024.
claims.summary: Apple FY2024 revenue per 10-K is $391.035B, which rounds to the claimed $391.0B.
